System_Information.Title: Nguyen 2022 - Fig. 4, 50 % CO2 in He
System_Information.Description: CO2 breakthrough on CALF-20 (Nguyen et al. 2022, Fig. 4): 50 % CO2 in He fed at 50 cm3/min into a column full of helium. The measured outlet composition and the thermocouple 1.82 cm from the outlet, re-digitised from the paper's figure, are bound to the deck (Experimental Data).
System_Information.Author: Sam Affleck
